author: Spread
name: Life ring
description: A percentage ring colored by how much is left: red, orange, yellow, green (tyre life, battery, health).
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 120 120"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.val{fill:none;stroke-width:6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:calc((1 - var(--v)) * 100);transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:60px 60px}.big{font-size:30px}.pc{font-size:15px}[data-level="0"] .val{stroke:#ef4444}[data-level="1"] .val{stroke:#ef4444}[data-level="2"] .val{stroke:#f97316}[data-level="3"] .val{stroke:#fb923c}[data-level="4"] .val{stroke:#facc15}[data-level="5"] .val{stroke:#facc15}[data-level="6"] .val{stroke:#a3e635}[data-level="7"] .val{stroke:#4ade80}[data-level="8"] .val{stroke:#22c55e}[data-level="9"] .val{stroke:#22c55e}[data-level="10"] .val{stroke:#22c55e}</style><circle class="trk" cx="60" cy="60" r="44" stroke-width="6"/><circle class="val" cx="60" cy="60" r="44" pathLength="100"/>
<text x="60" y="70" text-anchor="middle" class="num big">{{pct}}<tspan class="pc" dx="1">%</tspan></text></svg>
